error.title: Document exceeds the PSD size limits
error.description:
### Document is larger than PSD supports The document is **{width}x{height} px**, above the **{limit} px** PSD dimension limit (PSD also stops at a 2 GB file size). Photoshop has to save such a document as **PSB**; the workfile and the PSD layer extractions follow that format automatically.
### How to continue - **Resize** the document so that both sides are {limit} px or less, or - **Disable** the **Validate Document Size** validator in the publisher (it is optional) and publish the document as PSB, or - set the project's default workfile extension to `psb`.
Raster representations (PNG/JPG/TIFF) may still fail above 2 GB, that is reported by the extractor that hits the limit.
The validator can be disabled from the publisher's plugin list or in `ayon+settings://photoshop/publish/ValidateDocumentSize`.
